source: Tour cards: the short function line, what each stop highlights and what is inferred, per equipment kind. The purpose sentence and its citations are NOT kept here: scripts/orientation_tour.py reads them by unit ID from data/te_unit_purposes.json (one sentence per unit, each citing teprob.f lines, checked by scripts/test_te_topology.py), the only source of purpose text. Function lines are this tour's short paraphrase of the same cited code. Not reviewed by an operator.
topology_note: The published process has five major units: reactor, product condenser, vapor-liquid separator, recycle compressor and product stripper. U-100 'Feed System' is the seed model's grouping of the feed lines; in the simulator it is the vapour header where the feeds, the stripper overhead and the recycle mix. Stream connections follow the main repository's verified seed topology: the purge (S9, with FT-110, FV-110 and AT-129) leaves from the separator V-101, not the compressor.
inferred_note: Items marked inferred are not in the contract's stream list: cooling water and steam lines are drawn only because a final element's own description names the utility (TV-121, FV-117, FV-119).

feed.function: Flow control: each fresh feed has its own control valve; everything mixes in one header.

reactor.function: Heat removal: cooling water carries the heat of reaction away; the products leave as vapour.
inferred: cooling-water supply and return lines (from TV-121)

condenser.function: Vapour in, cooled stream out: cooling water takes the heat (the simulator counts it in the separator).
inferred: cooling-water supply and return lines (from FV-117)

separator.function: Phase split: vapour goes to the compressor or the purge; liquid holds a level and goes to the stripper.

compressor.function: Pressure boost: raises the recycle gas from separator to header pressure; a recycle valve spills some back.

stripper.function: Gas rises, liquid falls: the stripped gas returns to the feed header and steam heats the column.
